## 1–3. Data foundation (separate n8n sub-workflows)
SmartRetail APIs → raw capture → pagination/consolidation → DQ → PostgreSQL.
Preserve `no_row_returned` as unknown; flag negative QOH.
Connect only after API and table contracts are known.

## 4–5. Model development (Python)
Prepare historical data, analyze stockouts, engineer past-known features, chronological splits, compare models, deploy an approved version. Training does not run on each daily forecast.

## 6–9. Forecast and PO
Current connected path calls the deployed Modal sample model and checks its output. It previews POs using simulated inventory.
Future: real inventory position → deterministic PO engine → audited PostgreSQL records → buyer approval. No automatic supplier submission.

## 10–11. Website and AI (separate service)
Backend API reads stored results for dashboard and product pages. Chat retrieves current numeric facts from the API/database; RAG provides documentation context. The LLM only explains saved PO decisions.

## LOCAL_DATASET phase (current)
SmartRetail API details are not available yet. This branch reads the project's real historical dataset (pearcedale-lgbm-model/processed_output/clean_daily_sales.parquet + promotions_daily.parquet) through a small local HTTP bridge (model_testing/api.py, POST /local-dataset), exposed via the same cloudflared tunnel pattern already used for the Modal test bridge - n8n itself runs remotely (n8n.srv1691210.hstgr.cloud) and cannot read your local filesystem directly.

Set Run Configuration.local_dataset_api_url to the tunnel URL, and create an n8n Header Auth credential named 'Local Dataset API Key' matching your MODEL_TEST_API_KEY. /local-dataset now returns ~400 days of DAILY history per SKU (sales up to as_of_date, promotions through the 15-day horizon since promos are known in advance), not a single snapshot - the model needs real lag/rolling history to forecast. Modal rebuilds the same weekly features preprocess_features.py builds for the bundled data, using this history instead, and never falls back to bundled data for LOCAL_DATASET. Fields the historical dataset cannot provide (qoh, open_po_quantity, lead_time, product name, promotion date ranges) are still preserved as null/UNKNOWN in the per-SKU DQ snapshot, never fabricated.
